paragraphs: The XF 2.0d was introduced during the X260 generation (2015 onwards) as Jaguar's entry-level diesel option. It uses the Ingenium AJ200D — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel that's part of Jaguar Land Rover's modular engine family. The X260 generation replaced the older X250's Ford-sourced diesel engines with this new in-house unit, which went on to serve across multiple JLR models including the XE, F-Pace and E-Pace. The XF 2.0d is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace Ingenium AJ200D engines for every XF 2.0d on the road.

cards.body: A 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel fitted to the XF 2.0d throughout the X260 generation (2015–~2020). Known for timing chain wear over time — see the callout above. We replace the timing chain, injector seals, EGR components and gaskets as standard on every Ingenium AJ200D rebuild.
